data.narrative:
Blue Energy, a growth-stage nuclear energy company founded by Jake Jurewicz, has raised $380M to date. The valuation universe comprises 9 peers across nuclear energy—3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 6 private, including Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and Fuse Energy. This peer set is broad but lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables at similar valuation tiers to support reliable median multiples analysis.

A single applicable method—stage-progression analysis—anchors the valuation. Using total capital raised as a baseline proxy of $380M and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement, this method implies a valuation of $456M. No additional triangulation methods produced reliable results; peer-median analysis was inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-stage peers (zero same-stage, zero adjacent-stage comps meeting minimum thresholds), making sector-wide median estimation potentially misleading.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $388M to $524M, centered on $456M. This range reflects stage-based trajectory assumptions rather than market-driven multiples. Key uncertainties include the absence of granular comparables at Blue Energy's specific stage and valuation tier within nuclear energy, limiting cross-validation. Any valuation conclusion depends heavily on validation through investor benchmarking, project-stage risk assessment, and capital requirements for next-phase operations.
